title.zh-TW: 美財長要求輝達說明出口合規，接班仍未定案
title.en: US Treasury presses NVIDIA on compliance as CEO search continues

summary.zh-TW: 據中央社與路透，美財長貝森特要求輝達在10天內回答出口合規問題，並主張外部接班人。這是官員要求，非違規判決或任命結果。
summary.en: CNA and Reuters report that Treasury Secretary Bessent requested NVIDIA compliance answers within ten days and urged an external CEO search. Neither a violation finding nor a successor appointment was announced.

impact.zh-TW: 觀察合規回應與交付指引，不直接推定台灣供應鏈訂單改變。
impact.en: Watch compliance responses and delivery guidance, without assuming changes to Taiwanese supplier orders.

title.zh-TW: Fed 官員稱通膨仍待處理，並非新利率決議
title.en: Fed official flags inflation concerns, not a new rate decision

summary.zh-TW: 路透報導，施密德稱通膨偏高，Fed 有責任處理；他未明確主張再次升息。
summary.en: Reuters reports that Jeff Schmid said inflation remains too high and the Fed must respond. He did not explicitly call for another hike.

impact.zh-TW: 留意融資成本；談話不等於政策結果。
impact.en: Monitor financing costs; remarks do not determine policy outcomes.

title.zh-TW: Intel 遭股東提告，PC 需求揭露受質疑

summary.zh-TW: 路透報導，股東指控 Intel 未及時揭露 PC 需求與庫存壓力；訴訟指控尚非判決。
summary.en: Reuters reports that shareholders sued Intel over alleged delays in disclosing PC-demand and inventory pressures. The allegations are not a court finding.

impact.zh-TW: 觀察終端需求，勿把訴訟當成供應商損失。
impact.en: Watch end demand; litigation does not establish supplier losses.

title.zh-TW: 銀行股債帳面損益分化，最新報導揭露9月底數據
title.en: Taiwan bank valuation report highlights September-end exposures

summary.zh-TW: 中央社引述金管會數據，9月底銀行業股票未實現利益9371億元，債券未實現損失1920億元。這是產業帳面損益，並非11月已實現獲利。
summary.en: CNA cites regulator data showing banks had NT$937.1 billion in unrealized equity gains and NT$192 billion in unrealized bond losses at September-end. These are sector valuations, not November realized profits.

impact.zh-TW: 利率變動對淨利差與既有債券評價可能有不同影響，應分項觀察。
impact.en: Rate changes can affect interest margins and existing bond valuations differently; assess them separately.

title.zh-TW: 日本第三季 GDP 年化微縮，消費與設備投資分歧
title.en: Japan GDP contracts slightly as consumption and investment diverge

summary.zh-TW: 路透報導，日本第三季 GDP 年化減0.1%；消費季減0.3%，設備投資季增1.6%。年化與季增率不可混用。
summary.en: Reuters reports Japan Q3 GDP fell 0.1% annualized; consumption fell 0.3% quarter-on-quarter while capital spending rose 1.6%. These are different measurement bases.

impact.zh-TW: 分辨消費與企業投資，勿外推單一台廠營收。
impact.en: Separate consumer and investment demand; do not extrapolate company revenue.

reason.zh-TW: 晶圓代工產業可觀察 AI 晶片合規與客戶交付展望；這是關聯推論，沒有新訂單公告。
reason.en: Watch AI-chip compliance and customer delivery guidance as foundry-sector factors. This is an inference, not a new-order announcement.

risk.zh-TW: 政策變化與客戶排程可能影響需求，不能從官員談話直接估算營收。
risk.en: Policy and customer scheduling may affect demand; official remarks do not quantify revenue effects.

reason.zh-TW: 追蹤伺服器平台交付與客戶融資成本對建置時程的可能影響；報導未披露廣達訂單變動。
reason.en: Monitor platform deliveries and how customer financing costs may affect deployment timing. The reports disclose no Quanta order changes.

risk.zh-TW: 供應鏈合規、零組件取得與客戶延後投資都可能造成交付風險。
risk.en: Supply-chain compliance, component availability and delayed customer investment can affect deliveries.

reason.zh-TW: 以 PC 品牌觀察庫存與終端消費需求，對照公司後續揭露；Intel 訴訟不是華碩營運數據。
reason.en: Use the PC brand to monitor inventory and consumer demand against its own disclosures. Intel litigation is not ASUS operating data.

risk.zh-TW: 零組件成本、庫存與消費復甦速度可能分歧，不能把總體數據直接換算成公司獲利。
risk.en: Component costs, inventories and consumer recovery can diverge; macro data do not establish company profit.

reason.zh-TW: 作為金融類股觀察利差與債券評價變化；產業合計數字不是兆豐個別損益。
reason.en: Monitor interest margins and bond valuations as financial-sector factors. Aggregate bank figures are not Mega-specific results.

risk.zh-TW: 利率、匯率與避險成本方向未必一致，帳面利益也不等於已實現獲利。
risk.en: Rates, exchange rates and hedging costs can move differently; unrealized gains are not realized earnings.

reason.zh-TW: 以電源與工業自動化業務觀察企業設備投資需求；日本 GDP 報導沒有披露台達電訂單。
reason.en: Monitor business equipment investment through its power and industrial-automation activities. The Japan GDP report discloses no Delta orders.

risk.zh-TW: 區域需求、匯率及專案遞延可能不同步，總體設備投資成長不保證公司受益。
risk.en: Regional demand, currencies and project delays can diverge; aggregate investment growth does not guarantee company gains.
